_about: The label table for the 'what we say' path. The LLM sees exactly this list (id, name, description) and must answer with one id. The fallback text embedding and the asset build script read it too. Edit freely; re-run npm run build:assets afterwards.

labels.name: Storm
labels.description: dark thunderstorm clouds and an approaching storm over a natural landscape

labels.name: Still water
labels.description: a still lake or pond with calm water and a mirror-like reflection

labels.name: Flowing water
labels.description: moving river water, rapids or a stream running over rocks

labels.name: Wind in vegetation
labels.description: windswept trees or grass visibly bending in strong wind

labels.name: Coast and surf
labels.description: ocean surf or breaking waves along a rocky or sandy coastline

labels.name: Forest
labels.description: a forest, woodland path, or dense canopy, green, alive, peaceful

labels.name: Desert and dunes
labels.description: desert dunes, dry sand, and an arid open landscape, hot, dry, endless

labels.name: Mountains
labels.description: prominent mountain ridges or alpine peaks, huge, tall

labels.name: Snow and ice
labels.description: a landscape dominated by snow, a glacier, or frozen ice, cold, silent

labels.name: Fog
labels.description: thick fog or mist obscuring a landscape, mystery, invisible

labels.name: Geothermal
labels.description: a geothermal landscape with a geyser eruption or a colorful hot spring

labels.name: Aurora
labels.description: aurora borealis glowing above a natural landscape at night

labels.name: Volcano and lava
labels.description: an active volcano with glowing lava, lava flows, or eruption plumes

labels.name: Wetland
labels.description: marshes, wetland reeds, and shallow water, biodiversity, ecosystem

labels.name: Grassland
labels.description: a wide natural prairie or grassland landscape

labels.name: Autumn foliage
labels.description: autumn woodland with orange and red foliage, falling, colorful, golden

labels.name: Lightning
labels.description: visible lightning bolts striking over a natural landscape

labels.name: Cave
labels.description: the inside of a natural cave with rock formations, dark, scary

labels.name: Night sky
labels.description: a starry night sky or the Milky Way over nature

labels.name: Waterfall
labels.description: a distinct waterfall dropping from a cliff or rocky ledge

labels.name: Wildfire
labels.description: a wildfire with visible flames in forest or grassland

labels.name: Tide pool
labels.description: a natural tide pool among rocks in the intertidal zone

labels.name: Pollinators
labels.description: a bee, butterfly, or other pollinating insect on a flower, essential, vital

labels.name: Wild birds
labels.description: a wild bird in its natural habitat, free, flying, natural
